findings.quote: A new patient exam and X-rays are $129.
findings.why: The ficha limits the $129 new patient exam with X-rays to new patients paying without insurance, but the post states the price with no condition.
findings.fix: Add the qualifier, e.g. "For new patients paying without insurance, the new patient exam and X-rays are $129."

findings.quote: In-office whitening is $395. The new patient exam and X-rays are $129.
findings.why: The FAQ answer drops the ficha's condition (new patients paying without insurance) on the $129 price, so the answer is inaccurate as written.
findings.fix: Restate the FAQ answer with the same qualifier used in the ficha, and make the FAQ answer match the body text.

findings.quote: The ADA's [MouthHealthy page on whitening](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/teeth-whitening) covers sensitivity and what to ask your dentist.
